key_points: Huawei agrees to multiyear AI and 5G patent license, expecting Qualcomm to receive patent payments for the first time.
Arm trial resumes over chip testing tools, with potential billions in royalties at stake.
Qualcomm targets $40B non-handset revenue by (year unspecified), highlighting diversification efforts.
Analysts note exploding AI demand and tight memory capacity, which could benefit Qualcomm's chip sales.
Recent stock price declines (~2.2% over two days) and Musk's dismissal of SpaceX AI phone chip rumors weigh on sentiment.
